components.name: LineChart
components.description:
Figma Chart/Line-Chart (6643:63324): an Accent/Solid 2px line over an area fading Accent/Solid → Accent/Subtle, on a
dashed Border/Neutral/Pale grid with 6 Y labels; each X value is a sector (Active/Accent/Subtle rule, Solid when active)
and the active sector shows a Tooltip with its value. With `compare` it is Figma Chart/Multi-Line-Chart (15426:2521): the same
chart plus one dashed Color Chart Sector/Primary line, both values in the Tooltip and a legend. ←/→, Home/End move
between points.

props.name: data
props.description: One point per period (`{ label, value }`). Keep 4–12 periods.

props.name: label
props.description:
What the line measures ("Invoiced"), named in the legend and the summary once there is a `compare`. Default: the
 aria-label.

props.name: compare
props.description:
A comparison over the same periods — last year, the plan, what was collected — drawn as a 2px Color Chart
 Sector/Primary line at 40%, dashed 4 / 5, with a legend (Figma Chart/Multi-Line-Chart): one value per point of `data`, in order.

props.name: format
props.description: Formats axis labels, the Tooltip and the summary (`$23.4K`, `52 GB`). Default: 1.2K.

props.name: height
props.description: Height of the plot in px, lanes included (36px Tooltip lane on top, 28px X labels below).

props.name: aria-label
props.description: What the chart shows and over which range ("Revenue invoiced per month, Apr – Sep 2026").

props.name: initialIndex
props.description: The point active at first (its Tooltip shows). Default: the last one.

props.name: curve
props.description: `smooth` (default, Figma's curve) or `linear` segments.

props.name: fill
props.description: The area under the line: `gradient` (default, Accent/Solid → Accent/Subtle) or `none`.

props.name: showLegend
props.description: The legend of the line and its comparison (default on with `compare`; colour is never the only key).

props.name: legendPosition
props.description: Legend above or below the plot (default bottom).

props.name: animate
props.description: Draw the line in from the left on mount and when the data changes (default true; reduced motion fades).

props.name: showAverage
props.description: A dotted line at the mean of the line (not the comparison), tagged "Avg $95.4K" (Figma Show Average).

components.name: BarChart
components.description:
Bar chart in the shared chart language (docs/research/chart-family-spec-2026-10-12.md): Chart/Sector/Primary bars with
Corner-Radius/Small, the active one Chart/Sector/Secondary with its Tooltip; projected bars and target tracks hatched
in Border/Neutral/Subtle. Vertical: the Line chart's frame (dashed grid, 6 Y labels, X pills, ←/→). Horizontal: a
category column, 24px bars and a value axis below (↑/↓). Home/End jump to the first and last bar. Figma Chart/Bar-Chart
15321:84071 (Orientation=Vertical 15321:80574 · Horizontal 15321:82941); the hatch is .Chart/Hatch 15321:475.

props.name: data
props.description:
One bar per category or period (`{ label, value }`); mark a forecast `projected` (hatched) and give a bar a `target`
 to draw its goal as a hatched track behind it. Keep 3–12 bars.

props.name: orientation
props.description: `vertical` columns over periods (default) or `horizontal` bars for categories with longer names (Q1–Q4, teams).

props.name: format
props.description: Formats axis labels, the Tooltip and the summary.

props.name: height
props.description: Height of a vertical plot in px, lanes included. Horizontal charts take the height of their rows.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: What the chart shows and over which range ("Revenue per month, Jan – Dec 2026").

props.name: initialIndex
props.description: The bar active at first (painted Chart/Sector/Secondary, its Tooltip shown). Default: the last bar that isn't projected.

props.name: color
props.description: Colour of the bars. Default Chart/Sector/Primary.

props.name: activeColor
props.description: Colour of the active bar. Default Chart/Sector/Secondary.

props.name: animate
props.description: Grow the bars from the baseline on mount and when the data changes (default true; reduced motion fades).

props.name: showAverage
props.description: A dotted line at the mean of the bars that aren't projected, tagged "Avg $87.8K" (Figma Show Average).

components.name: StackBarChart
components.description:
Figma Chart/Stack-Bar-Chart (6643:73471): one column per sector (2px side padding, Corner-Radius/Small on the column),
segments in series order from the bottom, a 12px-dot legend (Caption/Regular), and a Tooltip with the active total.

props.name: data
props.description: One column per period, a value per series id (`{ label: "Sep", values: { design: 2650, … } }`).

props.name: series
props.description: The stacked series, bottom first, in palette order unless a series sets `color`.

props.name: format
props.description: Formats axis labels, the Tooltip total and the summary.

props.name: height
props.description: Height of the plot in px, lanes included.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: What the chart shows and over which range.

props.name: initialIndex
props.description: The column active at first. Default: the last one.

props.name: showLegend
props.description: The legend names every colour; keep it (harness: chart/stack-needs-legend).

props.name: legendPosition
props.description: Legend above or below the plot (default bottom).

props.name: animate
props.description: Grow the columns from the baseline on mount and when the data changes (default true; reduced motion fades).

props.name: showAverage
props.description: A dotted line at the mean of the column totals, tagged "Avg 5.9K h" (Figma Show Average).

components.name: DonutChart
components.description:
Donut chart in the shared chart language (docs/research/chart-family-spec-2026-10-12.md): slices in palette order,
parted by 4px gaps of the same width from the hole to the rim (a mask, so the card shows through), a Surface/Default %
pill (Label/Small/Medium) on each slice of 6% or more, and the total in the centre (Heading/4, Caption/Regular caption)
— or, with `totalPosition="start"`, beside the ring above the legend (Body/Small/Regular caption, Heading/3 figure, as
the Chart Card's description and value). Hover or ←/→ pick a slice: the centre shows it and the others dim; Home/End jump
to the first and last slice, and leaving the chart shows the total again. Figma Chart/Donut-Chart 15324:80365
(Legend=Bottom · Start).

props.name: data
props.description: The shares of one total (`{ id, label, value }`), drawn clockwise from 12 o'clock in palette order. Keep 2–7 slices.

props.name: format
props.description: Formats the centre figure and the summary.

props.name: size
props.description: Diameter in px (default 200). The ring is 22% of it; it never grows past its box.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: What the chart shows ("Spending by category, September 2026").

props.name: value
props.description: The total figure. Default: the total, formatted. The active slice's value replaces it while one is picked.

props.name: label
props.description: The caption of the total ("Invoiced in Q3"). Default: the locale's “Total”.

props.name: totalPosition
props.description:
Where the total sits: in the hole (`centre`, default), or above the legend in a start column beside the ring
 (`start`: the hole stays empty, the legend lists down that column; Figma Total=Start).

props.name: showPercent
props.description: A % pill on every slice of 6% or more (default true).

props.name: showLegend
props.description: The legend names every slice (default true; colour is never the only key).

props.name: legendPosition
props.description:
Legend below (default), above, or beside the ring (start / end). With `totalPosition="start"` it is always in the
 start column, under the total.

props.name: animate
props.description: Grow every slice from its start angle on mount and when the data changes (default true; reduced motion fades).

components.name: RadialChart
components.description:
Radial chart (ring gauges) in the shared chart language (docs/research/chart-family-spec-2026-10-12.md): concentric
10px rings in palette order with round ends, each over a dotted Border/Neutral/Subtle track, and a centre figure
(Heading/4, Caption/Regular caption). Hover or ←/→ pick a ring: the centre shows it and the others dim; Home/End jump
to the outer and inner ring. Figma Chart/Radial-Chart 15325:1135 (Legend=Bottom · End).

props.name: data
props.description: One ring per measure, outermost first (`{ id, label, value }`), each measured against `max`. Keep 1–4 rings.

props.name: max
props.description: The value a full ring stands for (default 100: the values are percentages).

props.name: format
props.description: Formats the centre figure and the summary. Default: the share of `max` in whole percent ("43%").

props.name: size
props.description: Diameter in px (default 200). Rings are 10px with 8px between them; the chart never grows past its box.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: What the chart shows ("Budget used by area, September 2026").

props.name: value
props.description: The centre figure. Default: the outer ring's value, formatted. The active ring's value replaces it while one is picked.

props.name: label
props.description: The caption under the centre figure. Default: the outer ring's label.

props.name: showLegend
props.description: The legend names every ring (default true; colour is never the only key).

props.name: legendPosition
props.description: Legend below (default), above, or beside the rings (start / end).

props.name: animate
props.description: Sweep every ring from 12 o'clock to its value on mount and when the data changes (default true; reduced motion fades).

components.name: HeatmapChart
components.description:
Heatmap in the shared chart language (docs/research/chart-family-spec-2026-10-12.md): a 24px-tall cell per row ×
column (Corner-Radius/Small, Spacing/Gap/2XSmall apart) on 5 Support/Brand steps, column labels on top and row labels
on the left (Label/Small/Medium, Neutral/Light), a Less → More scale (Caption/Regular). Hover or the arrow keys pick a
cell (its row and column labels light up and its Tooltip reads "Tue 1 pm · 55 h"); Home/End jump to the row's first and
last cell. Figma Chart/Heatmap-Chart 15326:1043.

props.name: rows
props.description: Row labels, top to bottom ("1 pm", "2 pm"…).

props.name: columns
props.description: Column labels, left to right ("Mon", "Tue"…).

props.name: values
props.description: One value per row per column: `values[row][column]`.

props.name: format
props.description: Formats the Tooltip and the summary ("14 sessions").

props.name: max
props.description: The value of the deepest step. Default: the largest value.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: What the chart shows ("Studio sessions by weekday and hour, September 2026").

props.name: showLegend
props.description: The Less → More scale under the grid (default true).

props.name: animate
props.description: Fade the cells in, row by row, on mount and when the values change (default true; reduced motion only fades).

components.name: ChartCard
components.description:
Figma Chart/Chart-Card (6643:63528): Card Flat Medium (padding 24, radius 24) → header · Segmented · chart, gap 16.
The header row holds an optional icon, the title and the open chevron; a description and the headline value follow it
(every Figma chart card's Show Icon · Icon · Title · Show Description · Description · Show Value · Value · Show Ranges ·
Show Open properties).

props.name: title
props.description: Figma Header Label (Heading/Subheading).

props.name: headingLevel
props.description:
Heading level of the title: one level below the nearest heading above (default 3: a card inside an h2 section; 2
 when the card sits directly under the page h1). The look stays Heading/Subheading — the level follows the outline,
 not the size. An EmptyState in `children` takes the next level in Body/Extra/Bold, below the card title.

props.name: icon
props.description: Icon before the title (20px, Content/Neutral/Strongest): an icon name or a node. Decorative; the title names the card.

props.name: description
props.description: One line under the title that says what the figure is ("Available revenue in your wallet"), Body/Small/Regular.

props.name: value
props.description: The headline figure the chart explains ("$4,346.00"), Heading/3 like a medium Metric.

props.name: onOpen
props.description: Figma Header trailing Button/Icon-Main XSmall Tertiary (chevron): opens the full report.

props.name: openLabel
props.description: Accessible name of the open button. Default: the locale's “Open report”.

props.name: ranges
props.description: Figma Segmented (Secondary) range switch.

props.name: rangesFullWidth
props.description:
The range switch fills the card and splits it into equal items (Figma Segmented FILL, default); `false` hugs its
 items, as on a wide card where a full-width switch would stretch far past its labels (Figma HUG).

props.name: theme
props.description:
Figma nested Card Theme: Flat (default) inside a panel or section; Shadow when the chart card sits on the canvas
 next to other Shadow cards (metric cards on a dashboard).

props.name: children
props.description: The chart, or an EmptyState before there is data (keep the card title; the Empty State is set one level below it).

props.name: overrides
props.description:
Figma instance overrides: props of the open button and range control it draws, by layer (`{ Open: { level: "secondary" }, "Ranges/Item[week]": { level: "primary" } }`). Written by Zen Studio;
 app code sets onOpen / ranges.
